title: HLSDebugger: Identification and Correction of Logic Bugs in HLS Code with LLM Solutions
problem: Logic bugs in High-Level Synthesis code are difficult to identify and correct, slowing hardware design cycles.
motivation: Automated HLS debugging with LLM assistance accelerates hardware design and improves code quality.
method: LLM-based encoder-decoder architecture for bug identification, categorization, and correction. Trained on 300k HLS code samples with bugs. Distinguishes bug location, type, and generates fixes.
key_novelty: First specialized LLM-based HLS debugger achieving 3x better bug correction than GPT-4.
contributions: LLM-based bug identification and correction for HLS
limitations: Limited to HLS code; effectiveness on heterogeneous hardware designs not evaluated.
